text.p: Grain and oilseed exports reported by USDA and private export sources.

WHEAT SALE - Pakistan bought 180,000 tonnes of Australian wheat and 135,000 tonnes of U.S. soft white wheat at $150 to $155 a tonne, a U.S. official said on Wednesday. The U.S. agriculture attache said he expected Pakistan to tender again for a similar quantity around February 9.

On Tuesday Algeria bought 75,000 tonnes of French soft wheat for shipment in February and March at $150 per tonne FOB Exporters said cost of the price of the initial 75,000 tonnes was $178.75 per tonne.

SOYBEAN MEAL SALE - The Commodity Credit Corp said it bought 2,650 tonnes of soybean meal for donation to Guatemala from Louis Dreyfus Corp. Shipment is slated for between Jan 30 and Feb 25, and the sale was priced at $290.93 per tonne.
WHEAT TENDERS - Morocco said Tuesday it will buy 40,000 tonnes of optional origin soft wheat for delivery in the first half of February on January 16.

- Armenia is seeking about 65,000 tonnes of U.S. hard red winter wheat under the PL 480 program for January 23-February 6 delivery, its U.S. export agent said. Offers are to be submitted on January 15 and will be valid until January 16.

- News was awaited on Yemen's recent tender for soft wheat grain and soft wheat flour on January 14, grain traders said. Yemen is seeking 200,000 tonnes of European or U.S soft wheat flour for shipment by June. Within the EU, Yemen is seeking French, Dutch, German or Belgian flour. It also seeks 200,000 tonnes of optional soft wheat for shipment between June and August.
Lebanon's economy ministry plans to buy 50,000 tonnes of U.S. hard wheat later this month, the Cereals and Sugar Beet Office said. "It will be Hard Red Winter No.2," the official said.

- Bangladesh seeks 100,000 tonnes of U.S. No.2 wheat or Australian standard or better Canadian winter red/spring wheat for shipment by February 21. Offers are to be opened Jan 18 and results announced two to three days later.

BARLEY TENDER - The Cyprus Grain Commission has invited tenders for the supply of one cargo of 25,000 tonnes of feed barley, with the tender closing January 17 and shipment between January 22 and February 5.
CORN TENDER - South Africa's Maize Board said on Monday it would offer by a tender 15,000 tonnes of yellow maize for either export or domestic use. The offer would close Jan 16.

CORN AND SOYBEAN TENDER - Taiwan's CK group will tender on Thursday for a combined shipment of 54,000 tonnes of U.S. No. 2 corn and soybeans. The corn tender for 46,000 tonnes and the soybean tender for 8,000 tonnes are for shipment February 25 to March 11, traders said.
VEGETABLE OIL TENDER - Egypt will tender for between 15,000 and 25,000 tonnes of vegetable oils for delivery in the first half of March to January 21, a government official said.
RICE TENDER - Syria's General Foreign Trade Organization for Chemicals and Foodstuffs is seeking to buy 12,000 tonnes of white rice for March shipment. Results would be Feb 13.
MARKET TALK - A sharp rise in Malaysian palm olein prices is making Indian edible oil importers opt for sunflower oil from Argentina and the U.S., industry officials and traders said on Wednesday.
Croatia will have to import 40,000 to 80,000 tonnes of wheat to bridge a consumption gap until this year's harvest, the agriculture ministry said on Wednesday.
A senior Russian grains source said on Wednesday that one or several Russian organizations bought several 12,000 tonne cargoes of U.S. No. 2 corn at the end of last year.
